mutant.lineText: return `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${lw + vw}" height="20" role="img" aria-label="${l}: ${v}"><title>${l}: ${v}</title><rect width="${lw}" height="20" fill="#555"/><rect x="${lw}" width="${vw}" height="20" fill="${COLOURS[status]}"/><g fill="#fff" font-family="Verdana,sans-serif" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle"><text x="${lw / 2}" y="14">${l}</text><text x="${lw + vw / 2}" y="14">${v}</text></g></svg>`;
